literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe C-terminal GFP or 3×FLAG fusions of full-length CALHM3. The authoritative topology places the C-terminus (residue 344) within the intracellular span (199–344); a C-terminal fusion therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface. No ledger line reports any tag insertion in either extracellular loop (EC1: 32–49, 18 residues between TM1 and TM2; EC2: 120–177, 58 residues between TM3 and TM4), nor at the N-terminus (1–10, also intracellular). The N-terminus is likewise intracellular (1–10), so a prepend tag would also face the cytoplasm. Because the ledger contains no evidence of a tag placed on the extracellular face of CALHM3, zero surface tag sites are reported. The C-terminal fusion site is recorded in other_positions as intracellular.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal GFP and 3×FLAG fusions (pEGFP-N1 / p3×FLAG) are appended after residue 344, which lies in the intracellular C-terminal domain (199–344); the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
